description: This file defines the 'PerformanceModuleController' class within the OrangeHRM Performance module, responsible for handling requests related to the performance functionalities. It inherits from AbstractModuleController and implements a handle method to redirect to a default performance module page.

classes.name: PerformanceModuleController
classes.description: Controller class for the Performance module, handling redirect actions to the default performance page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by retrieving the default performance module path and redirecting to it.
